settings.about.feedback.title: Help and feedback
settings.about.feedback.report_help: Opens a new issue on GitHub with Irori’s version, your system and graphics filled in. Nothing is sent until you submit it there.
settings.about.feedback.idea_help: Opens a new issue on GitHub to suggest something Irori could do.
settings.about.feedback.question: Ask a question
settings.about.feedback.question_help: Opens a new issue on GitHub to ask the developers.
settings.about.feedback.known_issues_hel: See the problems already reported, to check whether yours is one of them.
settings.about.update.flatpak: Flatpak keeps Irori up to date.
settings.about.update.system: Your system’s package manager keeps Irori up to date.
settings.about.update.source: This copy of Irori was built from source, so it doesn’t look for new versions.

settings.about.update.not_checked: Irori hasn’t looked for a new version yet.
settings.about.update.ready: Irori {version} is downloaded and checked. It goes in when Irori restarts.
settings.about.update.rolled_back: Irori {version} didn’t start, so Irori went back to {current}.

settings.actions.empty: No actions yet. Add a mod manager, an editor or a link to have it beside Play.
settings.actions.error.target: Choose a program or enter a link
settings.actions.target_placeholder: A program, or a link such as https://…
settings.art.no_screenshots: No screenshots of this game yet. Irori finds the ones you take while playing.
settings.art.not_an_image: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
settings.art.refetch_help: Reads this game’s title, details and art from {store} again and downloads its images afresh.
settings.backup.backup_description: Save a backup file of your Irori settings and library. Store logins are never included.
settings.backup.export_description: Save a list of your games, playtime, and categories as a file.
settings.backup.part_library: Favourites, hidden games, categories and custom art
settings.backup.restore_description: Restore a backup file from this or another computer.
settings.backup.restore_note: Settings are replaced. Favourites, categories and playtime are added to what you already have.
settings.backup.paths_checking: Checking the backup’s folders on this computer…
settings.backup.paths_found: {found} of {total} folders and Wine builds are on this computer
settings.backup.paths_all_found: Every folder and Wine build this backup names is on this computer
settings.backup.restored_missing_one: {count} folder or Wine build is still missing; its games use the defaults until you point them to it.
settings.backup.restored_missing_other: {count} folders or Wine builds are still missing; their games use the defaults until you point them to them.
settings.backup.auto_description: Irori automatically backs up your settings and library. Store logins are never included.
settings.backup.part_art: Downloaded game art (large; it can be downloaded again)
settings.backup.before_updates: Also back up before a new version of Irori first runs
settings.backup.list_empty: No backups in this folder yet
settings.sync.title: Sync between computers
settings.sync.description: Keep favourites, ratings, play statuses, categories, custom titles and playtime the same on each computer. Install folders, settings and store sign-ins stay on each one.
settings.sync.folder_hint: Pick a folder that Syncthing, Dropbox, Nextcloud, OneDrive or a network share keeps in sync. Irori adds an “Irori sync” folder inside it.
settings.sync.login_hint: The login is kept like your store logins, encrypted with a key from your system keyring. Use an app password if your server offers one.
settings.sync.device_name_hint: What your other computers call this one.
settings.sync.copies.title: Cloud copies
settings.sync.copies.description: Also keep Irori’s backups, Ludusavi’s save backups and your screenshots there, so a new computer can bring them back. Store sign-ins never go, and nothing is sent while you play.
settings.sync.copies.no_devices: No other computer keeps copies there yet.
settings.sync.copies.bring_hint: Nothing here is replaced. Backups go to the backup folder, where Backups offers to restore them; saves go to Ludusavi’s backup folder, only for games it has no backups of; screenshots go to Pictures/Irori.
settings.sync.rclone_missing: rclone reaches Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, SFTP, SMB and many more. Install it from its website or your package manager, then add a remote with “rclone config” in a terminal. Irori never sees your cloud login.
settings.sync.rclone_no_remotes: rclone has no remotes yet. Add one with “rclone config” in a terminal, then look again.
settings.sync.rclone_hint: Irori keeps its files in an “Irori sync” folder there. rclone keeps the account; Irori never sees it.
settings.sync.playtime_only_help: Playtime and sessions go both ways. Favourites, categories, ratings and play statuses set here stay here, and those set on your other computers don’t change this one. For a computer you don’t keep organised.
settings.sync.newer_version: Another computer runs a newer Irori. Update Irori here to sync with it.
settings.sync.unreadable: Some files in the sync folder couldn’t be read: {files}
settings.sync.no_devices: No other computer has synced here yet. Turn on sync there with the same folder.
settings.sync.conflicts_description: These changes made here were replaced by changes made at about the same time on another computer. The later change is kept.

settings.sync.conflict.category: Category “{category}”: kept the change made on {device} at {time}
settings.sync.conflict.category_game: {game} in “{category}”: kept the change made on {device} at {time}
settings.sync.conflict.custom: {game} (custom title or art): kept the change made on {device} at {time}
settings.sync.conflict.goal: Goal for {year}: kept the change made on {device} at {time}
settings.sync.conflict.playtime: {game} (playtime): kept the change made on {device} at {time}
settings.sync.conflict.journal: {game} (journal note): kept the change made on {device} at {time}
settings.clear_caches.description: Artwork and store data are downloaded again. Accounts, installed games and settings are kept.
settings.clear_caches.title: Clear caches?
settings.controllers.empty: No controllers connected. Plug one in or pair it over Bluetooth.
settings.egl.prefix_placeholder: Wine prefix with the Epic Games Launcher
settings.egl.prefix_required: Choose the Wine prefix where the Epic Games Launcher is installed.
settings.egl.synced: Synced with the Epic Games Launcher
settings.egl.unlinked: Unlinked from the Epic Games Launcher
settings.env_text.hint: One NAME=value per line. A launch line from ProtonDB such as PROTON_USE_WINED3D=1 gamemoderun %command% -dx11 works too: what comes before %command% sets GameMode, MangoHud or a wrapper, and what comes after becomes launch arguments.
settings.env_text.open_tooltip: Edit every variable at once, or paste a launch line from ProtonDB
settings.eos.progress.label: EOS overlay progress
settings.eos.remove.description: Games that use it lose Epic's in-game overlay until you install it again.
settings.eos.remove.title: Remove the EOS overlay?
settings.error.game_missing: The game is no longer in the library
settings.field.action_clear_caches.help: Delete cached covers and store metadata.
settings.field.action_clear_caches.tip: Clears cached cover art and store catalogs to free space or fix stale metadata. Installed games, accounts, saves, and settings stay intact.
settings.field.action_clear_caches.label: Clear caches
settings.field.action_import_heroic.help: Copy accounts, games, settings, and favourites from Heroic.
settings.field.action_import_heroic.tip: Copies signed-in store accounts, installed games, Wine settings, and favourites from Heroic without modifying Heroic’s own files.
settings.field.action_open_logs.label: Logs folder
settings.field.action_open_logs.tip: Opens the directory storing app and per-game launch logs so you can inspect errors or share a file when asking for help.
settings.field.action_reset_settings.hel: Reset all global and per-game settings to defaults.
settings.field.action_reset_settings.tip: Resets all global and per-game configuration toggles back to defaults. Does not uninstall games or delete saves.
settings.field.add_desktop_shortcuts.hel: Create a desktop shortcut when installing a game.
settings.field.add_desktop_shortcuts.tip: Places a launch icon on your desktop whenever a new game finishes installing.
Adds newly installed games to your operating system’s applications menu so you can search and launch them like native apps.
settings.field.add_steam_shortcuts.help: Register installed games as non-Steam games in Steam.
settings.field.add_steam_shortcuts.tip: Adds games installed in Irori into your Steam library as non-Steam games so you can launch them through Steam or use Steam Input.
settings.field.add_steam_shortcuts.label: Add to Steam
Cleanup script run automatically after the game exits (for example restoring desktop settings or syncing files).
settings.field.allow_installation_broken: Allow installing games whose anti-cheat blocks Linux.
Lets you install games whose online anti-cheat fails on Linux so you can still play offline modes or experiment.
settings.field.auto_install_dxvk.help: Translate DirectX 8 to 11 into Vulkan for Wine builds.
settings.field.auto_install_dxvk.tip: Installs DXVK into standalone Wine prefixes to translate DirectX 8 to 11 to Vulkan. Required for good 3D performance with plain Wine; Proton bundles its own.
settings.field.auto_install_dxvk.label: Install DXVK automatically
settings.field.auto_install_dxvk_nvapi.h: Expose NVIDIA DLSS and Reflex in Windows games.
settings.field.auto_install_dxvk_nvapi.t: Lets supported NVIDIA cards expose DLSS upscaling, Frame Generation, and Reflex inside Windows games.
settings.field.auto_install_vkd3d.help: Translate DirectX 12 into Vulkan for Wine builds.
settings.field.auto_install_vkd3d.tip: Installs VKD3D-Proton into standalone Wine prefixes so DirectX 12 games run over Vulkan. Proton already ships with it.
settings.field.auto_install_vkd3d.label: Install VKD3D-Proton automatically
settings.field.auto_sync_saves.help: Sync cloud saves before launch and after exit.
settings.field.auto_sync_saves.tip: Automatically downloads newer cloud saves before launching and uploads new saves after closing so progress stays synced across devices.
settings.field.auto_sync_saves.label: Sync saves automatically
settings.field.auto_update_components.he: Keep Wine, Proton, and emulator builds up to date.
settings.field.auto_update_components.ti: Downloads newer Wine, Proton, DXVK, and emulator versions once a day in the background. Existing games continue working safely with or without this.
settings.field.auto_update_from.label: Automatic updates from
settings.field.auto_update_from.tip: Earliest hour of the day automatic updates may start on their own. Updates you start by hand always begin right away.
settings.field.auto_update_games.help: Queue game updates automatically when found.
settings.field.auto_update_games.tip: Queues and downloads game patches automatically when detected. Leave off if you play modded games or prefer deciding when large patches run.
settings.field.auto_update_games.label: Update games automatically
settings.field.auto_update_unmetered.hel: Wait for a non-metered connection on Linux and Windows.
settings.field.auto_update_unmetered.tip: Pauses background updates while you are on a metered connection (such as a mobile hotspot) so large downloads do not eat your data cap.
settings.field.auto_update_until.label: Automatic updates until
settings.field.auto_update_until.tip: Hour when automatic background updates stop starting. Leave both set to Any time to allow updates all day.
settings.field.auto_update_window.help: Automatic updates only start inside this window.
settings.field.battleye_runtime.label: BattlEye runtime
settings.field.battleye_runtime.tip: Enables the Proton BattlEye compatibility runtime required by BattlEye multiplayer games that support Linux.
settings.field.before_launch_script_alon: Start the game right away and stop the script on exit.
Starts the game right away without waiting for the pre-launch script to finish, then stops that script when the game closes.
Run the before-launch script alongside the game
settings.field.before_launch_script_path: Script or tool run automatically right before the game starts (such as switching audio profiles or mounting mods).
Switch to Big Picture when launched from Steam Game Mode.
Detects SteamOS Game Mode or Steam Big Picture environments (such as on Steam Deck) and switches straight to Irori’s gamepad-friendly UI.
Open Big Picture in Steam’s Game Mode
settings.field.big_picture_on_controller: Open Big Picture when a controller connects
Switch to Big Picture when you connect a controller.
Automatically enters full-screen Big Picture mode when you plug in or wake a controller while no game is running.
settings.field.big_picture_fullscreen.he: Off, Big Picture opens in Irori’s window as it is, for a second screen or a window you keep beside others. Leaving Big Picture puts the window back as it was either way.
settings.field.check_for_updates_on_star: Check for game updates on startup
Checks your connected stores for pending game patches as soon as Irori opens. Nothing downloads automatically unless auto-update is also enabled.
settings.field.check_for_app_updates.hel: Checks GitHub once a day for new Irori releases.
settings.field.check_for_app_updates.tip: Alerts you when a newer Irori release is posted on GitHub. Flatpak and Linux distribution packages update through your system instead.
settings.field.check_for_app_updates.lab: Check for new versions of Irori
settings.field.check_updates_interval.he: Minutes between background update checks (5 to 1440).
settings.field.check_updates_interval.ti: Controls how frequently Irori checks stores for game patches in the background. Values between 10 and 60 minutes balance freshness and bandwidth.
settings.field.launchers_rescan.label: Scan external launchers
settings.field.launchers_rescan.help: Minutes between scans for other launchers (0 = manual).
settings.field.launchers_rescan.tip: Automatically checks Battle.net, EA app, Ubisoft Connect, Rockstar, and Xbox app for newly installed titles. Set to 0 to scan only on manual refresh.
settings.field.comet_support.help: Enable GOG Galaxy achievements and online play via Comet.
settings.field.comet_support.tip: Runs the open-source Comet helper alongside GOG games so GOG Galaxy achievements, leaderboards, and online multiplayer keep working.
settings.field.comet_support.label: GOG Galaxy features (Comet)
settings.field.dark_tray_icon.label: Dark tray icon
settings.field.dark_tray_icon.tip: Switches the tray icon color if it is hard to see against a bright or dark desktop panel.
settings.field.default_install_path.help: Where new games are installed unless you pick another folder.
settings.field.default_install_path.tip: Irori suggests this folder whenever you install a new game. Changing it later does not move games you already installed.
settings.field.install_per_store.help: Keep each store’s games in its own subfolder.
settings.field.install_per_store.tip: Creates one subfolder per store inside your install folder, such as GOG/Game or Epic/Game, so files from different stores stay organized.
settings.field.panel_library_folders.hel: More folders games can be installed into, such as another drive or an SD card. The install sheet offers each, after the default install folder.
settings.library_folders.remove: Remove from the list; its games stay where they are
settings.library_folders.already: That folder is already in the list
settings.field.install_per_store.label: A folder for each store
settings.field.default_steam_path.help: Folder where your Steam installation lives.
settings.field.default_steam_path.tip: Lets Irori detect your installed Steam games, reuse Steam’s Proton builds, and register non-Steam shortcuts.
settings.field.default_steam_path.label: Steam folder
settings.field.crossover_bottles_path.he: Irori uses the folder CrossOver’s own preferences name. Set this only to use another folder, for example on an external drive.
settings.field.crossover_bottles_path.ti: Only needed if you moved your CrossOver bottles folder to an external drive or custom location in CrossOver’s preferences.
settings.field.compat_tools_path.label: Folder for downloaded Wine and Proton
settings.field.compat_tools_path.help: Custom folder for downloaded Wine and Proton builds.
settings.field.compat_tools_path.tip: Pick a custom directory for Wine and Proton builds downloaded by Irori, or leave blank to use the default data folder.
settings.field.default_wine_prefix_dir.h: Where Windows games store their simulated Windows folders.
settings.field.default_wine_prefix_dir.t: Each Windows game on Linux or macOS gets its own simulated C: drive here for configs and local saves. Changing this affects future installs.
settings.field.descriptor_heap.help: Lower DirectX 12 overhead on newer graphics drivers.
settings.field.descriptor_heap.tip: Experimental VKD3D-Proton optimization that can boost DirectX 12 efficiency on modern drivers. Turn off if a game crashes or shows corrupted graphics.
settings.field.descriptor_heap.label: Descriptor heap
settings.field.disable_animations.label: Turn off animations
settings.field.disable_animations.tip: Turns off all UI motion and fade transitions so views and panels switch instantaneously.
settings.field.disable_controller.help: Use controllers only in games, not in Irori menus.
settings.field.disable_controller.tip: Prevents controllers from moving menus inside Irori. Games still receive your controller inputs normally once started.
settings.field.disable_controller.label: Disable controller navigation
settings.field.disable_gog_presence.tip: Hides your live “currently playing” online status from GOG friends while launching GOG games through Irori.
settings.field.disable_logs.help: Stop writing diagnostic logs to disk.
settings.field.disable_logs.tip: Stops Irori from saving diagnostic logs on disk. Leave logs enabled whenever troubleshooting problems or filing a bug report.
settings.field.disable_logs.label: Turn off logs
settings.field.disable_playtime_sync.tip: Keeps your hours played saved only on this computer instead of uploading session time back to Epic or GOG.
settings.field.disable_umu.help: Run Proton directly without umu’s automatic fixes.
settings.field.disable_umu.tip: umu automatically applies community Proton game fixes outside Steam. Keep umu enabled unless debugging a rare regression.
settings.field.disable_umu.label: Don't use umu-launcher
settings.field.no_wine.label: Don’t use Wine
settings.field.no_wine.help: Start the game’s program directly, without Wine or Proton: for a native replacement such as OpenJK or fallout2-ce chosen as its program. Programs of this system are recognised and started this way anyway; a Windows program never is.
settings.field.discord_client_id.help: Optional custom Discord app ID instead of Irori’s default.
settings.field.discord_client_id.tip: Optional custom app ID from discord.com/developers if you want a custom label on your Discord status instead of Irori’s default.
settings.field.discord_client_id.label: Your own Discord application ID
settings.field.dll_overrides.help: Choose native (game) or builtin (Wine) DLL loading.
settings.field.dll_overrides.tip: Advanced: forces Wine to load a game or mod DLL file from the game folder (native) instead of Wine’s built-in version (builtin).
settings.field.dll_overrides.label: DLL overrides
settings.sunshine.found: Sunshine is set up here, its web UI on port {port}
settings.sunshine.found_flatpak: Sunshine from Flathub is set up here, its web UI on port {port}
settings.sunshine.never_ran: Sunshine is installed but hasn’t run yet. Start it once and choose a user name and password in its web UI.
settings.sunshine.missing: Sunshine isn’t installed on this computer.
settings.sunshine.login_hint: The user name and password you chose in Sunshine’s web UI. They’re kept like your store logins, encrypted with a key from your system keyring.
settings.sunshine.description: Sunshine streams games from this computer to Moonlight on a phone, TV or another computer. Irori keeps your games among its applications, with their covers, and updates them as your library changes.
settings.sunshine.quit_hint: Quitting a game in Moonlight stops it in Irori, and its playtime counts as usual. What you set on a game in Sunshine, such as preparation commands, stays.
settings.requires.sunshine: Turn on “Add games to Sunshine” first
settings.field.sunshine_enabled.label: Add games to Sunshine
settings.field.sunshine_enabled.help: Export Irori games to Sunshine for Moonlight streaming.
settings.field.sunshine_enabled.tip: Registers your Irori games inside Sunshine so you can stream and start them remotely from any Moonlight device.
settings.field.sunshine_games.label: Games in Sunshine
settings.field.sunshine_games.tip: Choose whether every installed Irori game is exported automatically or only the games you pick individually.
settings.field.sunshine_big_picture.help: Expose an “Irori Big Picture” entry in Sunshine.
settings.field.sunshine_big_picture.tip: Adds an Irori Big Picture entry to Moonlight so you can browse your whole library from a TV or handheld with a gamepad.
settings.field.sunshine_address.label: Sunshine on another computer
settings.field.sunshine_address.help: Web UI URL if Sunshine runs on another PC.
settings.field.sunshine_address.tip: Address of Sunshine’s web interface if streaming runs on a different PC (such as htpc.local:47990). Leave blank when Sunshine is on this PC.
settings.field.panel_sunshine.label: Sunshine
settings.field.panel_sunshine.tip: Shows Sunshine connection status, lets you sign in, and syncs your game entries immediately.
settings.field.sunshine_match_client.hel: Pass your Moonlight screen resolution and HDR to games.
settings.field.sunshine_match_client.tip: Forwards your Moonlight device’s display resolution, refresh rate, and HDR state to games started through Sunshine.
settings.field.in_sunshine.label: List in Sunshine
settings.field.in_sunshine.help: Include this game in Sunshine when syncing is active.
settings.field.in_sunshine.tip: Controls whether this specific game appears in Sunshine for Moonlight streaming when Sunshine integration is enabled.
settings.field.discord_presence.label: Show on Discord
settings.field.discord_presence.help: Show this game on Discord while Rich Presence is on.
settings.field.discord_presence.tip: Hide or show just this game on your Discord profile without turning off Discord Rich Presence globally.
settings.field.steam_overlay.label: Steam overlay from Steam shortcuts
settings.field.steam_overlay.help: When Steam starts this game through its non-Steam shortcut (Add to Steam), show Steam’s overlay in it. Not with gamescope or the sandbox.
settings.sunshine.found_apollo: Apollo is set up here, its web UI on port {port}
settings.sunshine.apollo_works: Apollo, Sunshine’s fork with virtual displays, works the same way.
settings.sunshine.apollo_session: Apollo keeps one sign-in at a time: when Irori signs in, its web UI in your browser asks you to sign in again. Irori keeps its sign-in between syncs, so this is rare.
settings.sunshine.remote_hint: Its games start on that computer through its own Irori (irori on its PATH), so install Irori there with the same games.
settings.sunshine.cert_changed: Irori sent nothing to Sunshine, because its certificate isn’t the one it trusted at first. If Sunshine was reinstalled or made a new certificate, trust the new one. Otherwise something else may be answering at that address. New fingerprint: {fingerprint}
settings.field.discord_rpc.help: Show the game you are playing on your Discord profile.
settings.field.discord_rpc.tip: Shares which game you are currently playing, cover artwork, and session time on Discord. Can still be toggled off per game.
settings.field.discord_rpc.label: Discord Rich Presence
settings.field.dlss_indicator.label: Show the DLSS indicator
settings.field.dlss_indicator.tip: Displays NVIDIA’s small on-screen corner readout showing active DLSS preset, version, and internal resolution.
settings.field.dlss_upgrade.label: Upgrade DLSS
settings.field.dlss_upgrade.tip: Replaces outdated game DLSS files with a newer version automatically when using a compatible Proton build, improving sharpness and reducing ghosting.
settings.field.download_no_https.help: Use plain HTTP for Epic downloads (for LanCache proxies).
settings.field.download_no_https.tip: Only turn on if you run a local home caching server such as LanCache that requires plain HTTP for Epic downloads. Keep off otherwise.
settings.field.download_no_https.label: Download without HTTPS
New Proton downloads go into Steam’s compatibilitytools.d, and builds already in Irori’s folder are listed there too, so Steam games can use them once Steam restarts. Turning it off takes Irori’s listings out of Steam. Steam installed as a Flatpak or Snap can’t reach Irori’s folder.
Saves Wine and Proton builds you download inside Steam’s compatibilitytools.d folder so both Irori and Steam can select them.
settings.field.proton_cpu_level.label: Processor level of Proton builds
settings.field.proton_cpu_level.help: Proton-CachyOS and Proton-Wineland publish a build for newer processors (x86-64-v3, with AVX2) beside the one for any x86-64 processor. Automatic installs the newer build when this processor runs it. Applies to builds installed or updated from now on.
settings.field.dxvk_fps_cap.label: Frame rate limit
settings.field.dxvk_fps_cap.tip: Maximum frames per second (such as 60, 120, or 144) when the DXVK frame limiter above is active.
settings.field.dxvk_version.label: DXVK version
settings.field.dxvk_version.tip: Selects which DXVK release to use with standalone Wine builds for DirectX 8 to 11 games. Proton includes its own.
settings.field.eac_runtime.label: Easy Anti-Cheat runtime
settings.field.eac_runtime.tip: Enables the Proton Easy Anti-Cheat compatibility runtime so EAC multiplayer games that permit Linux can connect online.
settings.field.enable_dxvk_fps_limit.hel: Cap FPS in DirectX 9 to 12 games.
settings.field.enable_dxvk_fps_limit.tip: Uses DXVK’s low-overhead frame limiter to cap FPS, smooth frame pacing, or keep laptop fans quiet.
settings.field.fps_limiter.label: Frame rate limiter
settings.field.fps_limiter.help: What applies the limit. Automatic uses gamescope when the game runs in it, else MangoHud when it shows, else DXVK for a Windows game, else MangoHud without its overlay. Only MangoHud’s limit can change from the in-game overlay while you play.
settings.field.enable_dxvk_fps_limit.hel: Caps the frame rate through the limiter below: gamescope, MangoHud or DXVK.
settings.field.mangohud_hidden.label: Start MangoHud hidden
settings.field.mangohud_hidden.help: MangoHud loads with the game without showing; the in-game overlay shows it when you want.
settings.field.enable_esync.help: Lower CPU overhead for Windows synchronization.
settings.field.enable_esync.tip: Reduces CPU wait overhead in multi-threaded Windows games. Leave enabled unless an older game hangs right at startup.
settings.field.enable_esync.label: Esync
settings.field.enable_fsr.label: FSR upscaling (Wine fullscreen hack)
settings.field.enable_fsr.tip: Enables Wine/Proton’s built-in fullscreen FSR 1.0 upscaling when lowering the game’s resolution below your monitor size.
settings.field.enable_fsync.help: Faster thread synchronization than Esync on Linux.
settings.field.enable_fsync.tip: Faster thread synchronization than Esync on modern Linux kernels, helping prevent stutter in CPU-heavy games.
settings.field.enable_fsync.label: Fsync
settings.field.enable_hdr.label: HDR
settings.field.enable_hdr.tip: Allows HDR output in supported games on HDR monitors when using Wayland or gamescope. Turn off if colors appear washed out.
settings.field.enable_msync.label: Msync
settings.field.enable_msync.tip: Speeds up Windows thread synchronization on macOS, raising frame rates in CPU-limited games.
settings.field.ntsync.help: Fastest Windows sync on Linux 6.14+ kernels.
settings.field.ntsync.tip: Uses Linux 6.14+ native kernel Windows sync for top performance and accuracy. Modern Proton builds use it automatically when supported.
settings.field.ntsync.label: NTSync
settings.field.enable_wine_wayland.help: Run Wine natively on Wayland (ignored in gamescope).
settings.field.enable_wine_wayland.tip: Experimental: runs Wine directly on Wayland without XWayland (can help HDR and latency, though some games have fullscreen quirks). Ignored inside gamescope.
settings.field.enable_wine_wayland.label: Wine Wayland
settings.field.enable_wow64.help: Run 32-bit Windows games without 32-bit Linux libs.
settings.field.enable_wow64.tip: Lets 32-bit Windows games run inside 64-bit Wine without 32-bit Linux system libraries. Useful on minimalist distros; leave off if an old game acts up.
settings.field.enable_wow64.label: WoW64 mode
settings.field.environment_options.label: Environment variables
settings.field.environment_options.tip: KEY=VALUE variables passed to Wine/Proton or the game (for example MANGOHUD=1 or PROTON_NO_ESYNC=1).
settings.field.exit_to_tray.help: Keep Irori running in the tray when closing the window.
settings.field.exit_to_tray.tip: Closing the window keeps Irori running quietly in the system tray instead of quitting, so active downloads and updates can finish.
settings.field.exit_to_tray.label: Close to tray
settings.field.fsr4_upgrade.label: Upgrade to FSR 4
settings.field.fsr4_upgrade.tip: Upgrades supported FSR 3.1 titles to AMD FSR 4 on Radeon RX 9000 GPUs when running a compatible Proton build.
settings.field.gamepad_initial_repeat_de: Milliseconds before a held button repeats (50 to 500).
Time in milliseconds to hold a D-pad or stick direction before Irori begins scrolling rapidly through menus.
settings.field.gamepad_repeat_delay.help: Milliseconds between repeats while held (5 to 150).
settings.field.gamepad_repeat_delay.tip: Milliseconds between cursor steps while holding a direction after repeat starts. Lower values scroll faster.
settings.field.big_picture_hold_button.h: Hold this button in Irori to enter Big Picture.
settings.field.big_picture_hold_button.t: Holding this controller button anywhere inside Irori launches full-screen Big Picture mode without needing the mouse.
settings.field.big_picture_hold_ms.label: Big Picture hold duration (ms)
settings.field.big_picture_hold_ms.help: Hold duration before Big Picture opens (300 to 3000 ms).
settings.field.big_picture_hold_ms.tip: How long you must keep the button held (in milliseconds) before switching to Big Picture, preventing accidental opens.
settings.field.overlay.label: In-game overlay (beta)
settings.field.overlay.help: Hold Guide in a game for volume, screenshots, achievements, and notes.
settings.field.overlay.help_windows: Press Guide or Ctrl+Shift+O in a game for volume, screenshots, and notes.
settings.field.overlay.tip: Press the controller’s Guide button during a game to open volume, screenshots, achievements, and notes above the game (holding controller input until closed). Shortcuts: Guide + RB takes a screenshot and Guide + Up/Down adjusts volume. Works best on Wayland desktops with layer-shell (KDE Plasma, sway, Hyprland, COSMIC).
settings.field.overlay.tip_macos: Press the controller’s Guide button or Control+Shift+O during a game for volume, screenshots, achievements, and notes. The game still receives controller presses while open, only system volume adjusts, and screenshots require Screen Recording permission.
settings.field.overlay.tip_windows: Press the controller’s Guide button or Ctrl+Shift+O during a game for volume, screenshots, achievements, and notes. Windows reserves Xbox Guide for Xbox Game Bar, so use Ctrl+Shift+O there; switch exclusive fullscreen games to borderless so the overlay stays visible.
settings.field.overlay.help_macos: Press Guide or Control+Shift+O in a game for volume, screenshots, and notes.
settings.field.panel_overlay.label: On this computer
settings.field.overlay_side.label: Position on the screen
Works while the game has the window, without opening the overlay.
settings.field.overlay_screenshot_key.he: While a game Irori started runs, Ctrl+Shift+S (⌃⇧S on a Mac) takes a screenshot of it, with or without the overlay.
settings.field.overlay_moment_chord.help: Takes a screenshot and adds a note to the game’s journal to write later, without opening the overlay.
settings.field.overlay_volume_chords.lab: Guide + Up or Down changes the volume
settings.field.overlay_volume_chords.hel: Changes the system’s volume while the game has the window, without opening the overlay.
settings.field.overlay_volume_step.label: Volume step (%)
settings.field.overlay_volume_step.help: How far one press changes a volume, in the overlay and with Guide + Up or Down.
settings.field.overlay_level_notice.labe: Show the volume over the game
settings.field.overlay_level_notice.help: After Guide + Up or Down, the new level shows at the top of the screen for a moment.
settings.field.overlay_back_start.label: Back + Start opens the overlay
settings.field.overlay_back_start.help: Windows doesn’t let Irori read the Guide button while a game is in front, so Back (View) and Start (Menu) pressed together open and close the overlay instead. The overlay then takes the focus, so most games stop reading the controller until it closes.
settings.overlay.status.back_start: Back + Start on the controller opens it while a game is in front; the overlay then takes the focus and gives it back when it closes.
settings.requires.overlay: Turn the in-game overlay on first
settings.overlay.status.unavailable: The in-game overlay isn’t available on this system.
settings.overlay.status.surface_wayland: Opens above games as a layer on Wayland desktops with layer-shell (KDE Plasma, sway, Hyprland, COSMIC); on GNOME as a window, which may stay behind a fullscreen game.
settings.overlay.status.surface_x11: Opens as a window that stays above games on X11.
settings.overlay.status.surface_macos: Opens as a panel above games, also over full-screen ones, without taking them out of full screen.
settings.overlay.status.surface_windows: Opens above windowed and borderless games; games in exclusive fullscreen can’t be covered.
settings.overlay.status.controllers_held: Controllers connected: {count}. The game doesn’t see their presses while the overlay is open.
settings.overlay.status.controllers_shar: Controllers connected: {count}. The game also sees their presses while the overlay is open.
settings.overlay.status.game_volume: The game’s own volume can be changed, besides the system’s.
settings.overlay.status.system_volume_on: Only the system’s volume can be changed: this system has no volume per program.
settings.overlay.status.shortcut: {keys} opens it too, while a game Irori started runs.
settings.overlay.status.guide_only: The controller’s Guide button opens it.
settings.field.gamescope_additional_opti: Advanced command-line flags passed directly to gamescope (for example --hdr-enabled or --mangoapp).
settings.field.gamescope_enable_force_gr: Keep the cursor in the window
Locks the mouse pointer strictly inside the game window so fast camera turns do not click onto another monitor.
Turns on gamescope’s frame-rate limiter, useful when an in-game VSync setting stutters or ignores caps.
settings.field.gamescope_enable_upscalin: Render at lower resolution and upscale cleanly.
Makes the game render faster at a smaller size while gamescope sharply upscales it to fill your monitor.
settings.field.gamescope_enabled.help: Run inside a dedicated micro-compositor (needs gamescope).
settings.field.gamescope_enabled.tip: Runs the game inside its own virtual screen window, fixing stubborn fullscreen scaling, cursor lock, HDR, and FPS limits.
settings.field.gamescope_enabled.label: Run in gamescope
settings.field.gamescope_fps_limiter.tip: Maximum FPS allowed while the game window is active and focused.
settings.field.gamescope_fps_limiter_no_: Optional lower FPS cap when you Alt-Tab away so your GPU cools down in the background.
settings.field.gamescope_game_height.tip: Internal vertical pixel height reported to the game (for example 720 in 1280×720).
settings.field.gamescope_game_width.tip: Internal horizontal pixel width reported to the game (for example 1280 in 1280×720).
Final window or display height on your screen (usually your monitor’s native height).
Picks the scaling filter: FSR or NIS add crispness, Pixel keeps retro pixel art sharp, and Linear blends smoothly.
settings.field.gamescope_upscale_width.t: Final window or display width on your screen (usually your monitor’s native width).
settings.field.gamescope_window_type.tip: Chooses Fullscreen, Borderless fullscreen, or regular Windowed mode for the gamescope container.
settings.field.gog_saves.label: Save locations
settings.field.gog_saves.tip: Named save folder paths detected or added for GOG Galaxy cloud save synchronization.
settings.field.gpu.help: Pick which graphics card runs games on multi-GPU PCs.
settings.field.gpu.tip: Forces games to use a specific graphics card on PCs with both integrated graphics and a dedicated GPU.
settings.field.gpu.label: Graphics card
settings.field.windows_gpu.help: Choose High performance or Power saving GPU on Windows.
settings.field.windows_gpu.tip: Sets Windows’ per-app GPU preference so games always pick your dedicated graphics card over power-saving integrated graphics.
settings.field.windows_gpu.label: Graphics preference
settings.field.hide_gpu.label: Hide a graphics card
settings.field.hide_gpu.help: Windows turns this graphics card off while the game runs, so the game can’t pick it, and turns it back on when the game ends, also if the launch fails or Irori closes. Turning a device off needs an administrator, so Windows asks for your permission at each launch. Cards that show a display are never offered.
settings.field.hide_window_on_protocol_l: Keep the window hidden for shortcuts and launch links.
When you launch a game from a desktop shortcut or irori:// link, starts the game straight away without popping up the full Irori window.
settings.field.ignore_game_updates.help: Skip update checks and prompts for this game.
settings.field.ignore_game_updates.tip: Hides update prompts and skips automatic patches for this title, helpful when mods depend on a specific game version.
settings.field.ignore_game_updates.label: Ignore updates
settings.field.sandbox_no_network.label: Block the network
settings.field.sandbox_no_network.help: Block internet and LAN access for this game.
settings.field.sandbox_no_network.tip: Blocks internet and local network connections for this game on Linux. Safe for offline single-player titles.
settings.field.sandbox_no_home.label: Hide the home folder
settings.field.sandbox_no_home.help: Isolate the game from your personal home folder.
settings.field.sandbox_no_home.tip: Gives the game a private virtual home folder so it cannot read personal files or clutter your real home directory.
settings.field.language.help: Two- or four-letter code such as “fr” or “pt-BR”.
settings.field.language.tip: Overrides this game’s language when supported by its store or compatibility runner (such as pt-BR or en-US). Leave blank to follow Irori’s language.
settings.field.language.label: Game language
settings.field.launcher_args.help: Extra flags passed after the game command.
settings.field.launcher_args.tip: Extra flags appended to the game executable on launch (for example -novid, -skipintro, or -dx11).
settings.field.panel_steam_launch.label: Steam launch options
settings.field.panel_steam_launch.tip: Edits the Steam launch command string for this title so wrappers, MangoHud, or variables also apply when launched from Steam.
settings.steam_launch.help: The line Steam starts the game with, as in the game’s Properties in Steam: VAR=value wrapper %command% arguments. Steam keeps it, so Irori changes it only while Steam is closed.
settings.steam_launch.saved: Steam starts “{title}” with the new launch options
settings.steam_launch.save_failed: Couldn’t change the launch options in Steam
settings.steam_launch.load_failed: Couldn’t read the launch options from Steam
settings.steam_launch.running: Steam is running: saving asks to close it first.
settings.steam_launch.session: Steam runs this session, so Irori can’t close it. Change the launch options in Steam instead.
settings.steam_launch.close.title: Close Steam to change “{title}”?
settings.steam_launch.close.description: Steam keeps the launch options and rewrites them when it closes, so Irori closes Steam first. Games Steam runs close with it.
settings.field.launcher_args.label: Game arguments
settings.field.library_top_section.label: Above the library
settings.field.library_top_section.tip: Picks which quick strip shows above the main game grid (Recent games, Installed recents, Favourites, or Nothing for more vertical room).
settings.field.lsfg_enabled.help: Generate extra frames via lsfg-vk or MAKO.
settings.field.lsfg_enabled.tip: Generates intermediate frames with Lossless Scaling (lsfg-vk) or MAKO to smooth out 30 or 60 FPS games.
settings.field.lsfg_enabled.label: Lossless Scaling frame generation
settings.field.lsfg_flow_scale.tip: Controls motion tracking detail. Lowering this improves speed on 1440p/4K displays with slightly softer fast-moving edges.
settings.field.lsfg_flow_scale.label: Flow scale
settings.field.lsfg_layer.help: Pick lsfg-vk or MAKO Renderer for frame generation.
settings.field.lsfg_layer.tip: Selects lsfg-vk (uses your Steam copy of Lossless Scaling) or MAKO Renderer as the Vulkan frame-generation backend.
settings.field.lsfg_layer.label: Frame generation layer
settings.field.lsfg_multiplier.help: Generated frames per rendered frame (2× doubles FPS).
settings.field.lsfg_multiplier.tip: How many total frames to display per rendered frame. 2× is cleanest for latency; 3× or 4× suits 144Hz+ displays when base FPS is steady.
settings.field.lsfg_multiplier.label: Frame multiplier
settings.field.lsfg_performance_mode.hel: Faster model with slightly softer image quality.
settings.field.lsfg_performance_mode.tip: Uses a faster frame-generation pass to save GPU headroom on mid-range cards or high resolutions.
settings.field.max_download_speed.tip: Caps download speed in KB/s (for example 5000 KB/s is about 5 MB/s) so browsing or voice calls stay smooth while downloading.
settings.field.max_download_speed.label: Download speed limit
settings.field.max_recent_games.label: Recent games to keep
settings.field.max_recent_games.tip: Sets how many titles appear in the top Recently Played strip before older ones drop off.
settings.field.max_sharpness.label: FSR sharpness
settings.field.max_sharpness.tip: Sets FSR sharpening amount from 0 (strongest) to 5 (softest). Try 2 or 3 if textures look grainy.
settings.field.max_workers.help: Max parallel download connections (0 = automatic, up to 32).
settings.field.max_workers.tip: Controls how many download chunks run at once. Higher values help fast fiber lines; lowering to 2 to 4 helps keep Wi-Fi routers stable.
settings.field.max_workers.label: Parallel downloads
settings.field.minimize_on_launch.help: With “Close to tray” on, Irori hides to the tray instead. The window comes back when the game exits.
settings.field.minimize_on_launch.tip: Hides Irori while you play and brings the window back automatically as soon as the game closes.
settings.field.minimize_on_launch.label: Minimize while playing
settings.field.no_tray_icon.label: Hide tray icon
settings.field.no_tray_icon.tip: Removes the small Irori icon from your desktop notification area. Requires restarting Irori to take effect.
settings.field.nvidia_prime.help: Run games on the dedicated NVIDIA GPU on hybrid laptops.
settings.field.nvidia_prime.tip: Enables NVIDIA PRIME render offload on hybrid laptops so 3D games run on the NVIDIA GPU instead of integrated graphics.
settings.field.nvidia_prime.label: Use the discrete GPU
settings.field.nvidia_reflex.help: Reduce input latency in Vulkan games via DXVK-NVAPI.
settings.field.nvidia_reflex.tip: Reduces mouse-to-screen input delay when your GPU is near 100% usage in supported Vulkan games.
settings.field.nvidia_reflex.label: NVIDIA Reflex in Vulkan games
settings.field.shader_cache_size.label: Shader cache size (GB)
settings.field.shader_cache_size.help: Max disk size for driver shader cache (0 = driver default).
settings.field.shader_cache_size.tip: Sets how much disk space your GPU driver can reserve for compiled shaders. Raising this (for example to 10 or 16 GB) helps stop shaders from expiring and causing stutter.
settings.field.offline_mode.tip: Launches without contacting the store online. Useful on travel or outages, though games with strict online DRM may still refuse to start.
settings.field.offline_mode.label: Run offline
settings.field.panel_actions.help: Programs and links offered beside Play, in the game’s menu and in the command palette: a mod manager, a map editor, the game’s wiki.
settings.field.panel_actions.label: Actions
settings.field.panel_artwork.help: Customize this game’s cover, background, and logo locally.
settings.field.panel_artwork.tip: Customize covers, backgrounds, and logos just inside your Irori library without changing anything on the store.
settings.field.panel_artwork.label: Cover, background and logo
settings.field.panel_controllers.label: Connected controllers
settings.field.panel_controllers.tip: Shows which controllers Irori currently detects and lets you refresh connected gamepads.
settings.field.panel_egl_sync.help: Share installed games with an Epic Games Launcher Wine prefix.
settings.field.panel_egl_sync.tip: Links a Wine prefix containing Epic Games Launcher so installs done in either Irori or EGL show up in both without redownloading.
settings.field.panel_egl_sync.label: Sync with Epic Games Launcher (EGL)
settings.field.panel_eos_overlay.help: Epic’s overlay for friends, achievements, and purchases.
settings.field.panel_eos_overlay.tip: Installs or updates Epic’s in-game overlay used by some Epic titles for friend invites, achievements, and in-game purchases. Safe to skip unless a game asks for it.
settings.field.panel_eos_overlay.label: EOS overlay
settings.field.panel_sync_saves.help: Upload or download this game’s cloud saves immediately.
settings.field.panel_sync_saves.tip: Manually push local saves to the cloud, pull cloud saves down, or resolve conflicts for this game right away.
settings.field.panel_sync_saves.label: Sync saves now
settings.page.saves_description: Back up your game save files automatically with Ludusavi.
settings.game.changed.none: This game follows your game defaults. What you change for it is listed here, each with its own reset.
settings.field.ludusavi_auto_backup.help: Create a local Ludusavi backup when the game exits.
settings.field.ludusavi_auto_backup.tip: Runs Ludusavi automatically right after each game session exits (and after cloud sync completes) to keep local restore points.
settings.field.ludusavi_interval.label: Back up while playing
settings.field.ludusavi_interval.help: Periodic Ludusavi backup interval while playing.
settings.field.ludusavi_interval.tip: Creates rolling safety backups at your chosen interval during long sessions in case the game crashes.
settings.field.panel_save_backups.label: Save backups
settings.field.panel_save_backups.help: Back up now, pick a Ludusavi title, or restore saves.
settings.field.panel_save_backups.tip: Trigger a manual backup, restore any previous snapshot, or match this game’s title in Ludusavi.
settings.field.panel_ludusavi.label: Ludusavi
settings.field.panel_ludusavi.help: Back up game saves across every store using Ludusavi.
settings.field.panel_ludusavi.tip: Shows whether your installed Ludusavi binary is detected so Irori can create local backups for games from all stores.
settings.field.save_snapshots.label: Earlier saves kept per game
settings.field.save_snapshots.help: Before a cloud sync could replace a game’s saves, Irori copies them, so the game’s cloud saves can put them back. How many to keep, from 0 (none) to 50; unchanged saves aren’t copied twice.
settings.field.ludusavi_path.label: Ludusavi program
settings.field.ludusavi_path.help: Custom Ludusavi binary path (leave blank to auto-detect).
settings.field.ludusavi_path.tip: Point directly to a custom Ludusavi executable, or leave blank to detect it from your PATH, install folders, or Flathub.
settings.field.ludusavi_backup_path.help: Folder for backups (blank uses Ludusavi’s setting).
settings.field.ludusavi_backup_path.tip: Pick where Ludusavi writes backups created by Irori (such as an external drive or Syncthing folder), or leave blank for Ludusavi’s default.
settings.field.ludusavi_full_limit.label: Full backups per game
settings.field.ludusavi_full_limit.help: Number of full backups kept per game.
settings.field.ludusavi_full_limit.tip: Caps how many complete save backups stay stored per game. Oldest unlocked backups are cleaned automatically.
settings.field.ludusavi_differential_lim: Incremental snapshots saved between each full backup.
Incremental backups only save changed files since the last full backup, letting you keep extra restore points with little disk space.
settings.field.panel_launch_presets.help: Save and apply reusable launch profiles across games.
settings.field.panel_launch_presets.tip: A launch preset bundles variables, wrappers, gamescope, MangoHud, Wine build, and companion apps. Applying one only changes the keys saved inside it.
settings.field.panel_launch_programs.hel: Start companion apps or trainers alongside the game.
settings.field.panel_launch_programs.tip: Launches companion tools (trainers, voice chat, overlays, or scripts) alongside the game and logs their output with the game.
settings.programs.error.delay: Enter a delay from 0 to 600 seconds
settings.programs.path_placeholder: A file, or a command such as discord
settings.programs.name_placeholder: Shown in the list and the game’s log
settings.programs.name: Name
settings.programs.start_before_help: The game starts once it has waited the seconds above, for a server or tool the game looks for when it starts.
settings.programs.start_before_umu_help: Under umu, a program started before the game runs in a Steam runtime container of its own and can’t see the game’s processes. Start a trainer that attaches to the game with the game instead.
settings.programs.in_prefix: Run in the game’s Wine prefix
settings.programs.in_prefix_help: For Windows programs: they run with the game’s Wine or Proton build and see the same drives and saves.
settings.programs.in_prefix_steam_help: For Windows programs: they run in the Proton prefix Steam made for this game, through protontricks-launch.
settings.programs.in_prefix_umu_help: Under umu they join the Steam runtime container the game runs in, so they can see its processes. The game then takes a few seconds longer to start.
settings.programs.stop_with_game: Stop it when the game ends
settings.programs.inherited: These come from the game defaults. Changing them here gives this game a list of its own.
settings.presets.error.name: Name the preset
settings.presets.error.empty: There is nothing to save yet: no variables, wrappers, gamescope, MangoHud, Wine build or programs alongside are changed here.
settings.presets.remove.title: Delete the preset “{preset}”?
settings.presets.remove.description: Games it was applied to keep their settings.
settings.presets.save_help_game: Save as preset keeps the launch settings this game changes, to apply to other games later.
settings.presets.save_help_defaults: Save as preset keeps the launch settings these defaults change from Irori’s own.
settings.presets.dialog.title: Apply “{preset}”
settings.presets.dialog.help: Only the settings the preset holds change; the rest keeps following each game’s own settings and the defaults.
settings.presets.builtin.low_latency_nvi: One frame rendered ahead, NVAPI for Reflex in DXVK and VKD3D-Proton, and GameMode.
settings.presets.builtin.steam_deck_hand: Gamescope at the Deck’s 1280 × 800 with FSR and a 60 FPS limit, for desktop mode. Game Mode brings its own gamescope.
settings.presets.builtin.older_32_bit_ga: Four CPU cores and a short OpenGL extension list, which many games from before 2005 need to start.
settings.field.prefer_system_libs.help: Use host system libraries before Wine’s bundled ones.
settings.field.prefer_system_libs.tip: Tells Wine to prefer libraries installed on your Linux system over its bundled copies. Leave off unless debugging a specific audio or video codec issue.
settings.field.prefer_system_libs.label: Prefer system libraries
settings.field.proton_prefer_sdl.label: Use SDL controller input
settings.field.proton_prefer_sdl.help: Try this if a gamepad is missing or mapped wrong.
settings.field.proton_prefer_sdl.tip: Switches Proton input to SDL. Try this first if buttons are swapped, triggers stay stuck, or your gamepad is not recognized in-game.
settings.field.saves_path.label: Save folder
settings.field.saves_path.tip: Folder on this computer where the game writes save files used for cloud synchronization.
settings.field.secret_saved_placeholder: Saved — type a new key to replace it
settings.field.show_fps.label: Show FPS (DXVK HUD)
settings.field.show_fps.tip: Displays a minimal built-in FPS counter in the corner of DirectX 9 to 12 games via DXVK HUD without installing MangoHud.
settings.field.show_log_on_launch.help: Open the live launch log beside the library.
settings.field.show_log_on_launch.tip: Opens a live log pane beside your library whenever a game starts. Handy when troubleshooting why a title fails to launch.
settings.field.show_log_on_launch.label: Show the log when a game starts
settings.field.show_mangohud.help: Display FPS and hardware stats (needs MangoHud).
settings.field.show_mangohud.tip: Shows the MangoHud FPS, CPU, GPU, and frame-time overlay in-game. Customize its metrics in Performance HUD.
settings.field.show_mangohud.label: MangoHud overlay
settings.field.show_store_amazon.label: Show Amazon Games
settings.field.show_store_epic.label: Show Epic Games
settings.field.show_store_gog.label: Show GOG
settings.field.deals.label: Show deals
settings.field.deals.help: Lists discounts from GOG and other stores on the Stores page. Turned off, Irori doesn’t ask the stores for them.
settings.field.network_mode.label: Connection
settings.field.network_mode.help: Automatic checks the connection now and then. Always online skips that check, for networks that block it. Work offline never connects: no store refreshes, downloads, update checks or lookups, and installed games that can run offline still launch.
settings.field.network_timeout.label: Network timeout (seconds)
settings.field.network_timeout.help: How long Irori waits for a server before giving up, from 10 to 600. Raise it on slow or unreliable connections; 0 keeps Irori’s own timeouts.
settings.field.show_valve_proton.help: Show Valve’s official Proton builds alongside GE-Proton.
settings.field.show_valve_proton.tip: Lists Steam’s built-in Proton builds alongside GE-Proton. GE-Proton includes extra fixes for non-Steam games, so keep off unless a title needs stock Proton.
settings.field.show_valve_proton.label: Offer Valve Proton builds
settings.field.smooth_motion.help: Driver-level frame generation for supported NVIDIA GPUs.
settings.field.smooth_motion.tip: Uses NVIDIA driver-level frame generation on supported RTX GPUs to boost smoothness even in games without built-in DLSS Frame Generation.
settings.field.smooth_motion.label: NVIDIA Smooth Motion
settings.field.start_in_console_mode.tip: Opens directly in full-screen Big Picture mode instead of the desktop window, suited for TVs, living-room setups, or handheld PCs.
settings.field.start_in_tray.tip: Starts Irori silently in the system tray without opening the main window until you click the tray icon.
settings.field.start_in_tray.label: Start in tray
settings.field.ui_start_maximized.label: Start maximized
settings.field.ui_start_maximized.tip: Opens Irori filling the whole screen every time, regardless of the window size when you last closed it.
settings.field.steam_grid_db_api_key.hel: Unlock custom cover search from SteamGridDB.
settings.field.steam_grid_db_api_key.tip: Optional free API key from steamgriddb.com to browse and apply community covers, banners, and logos inside Irori.
settings.field.igdb.label: Game details and art from IGDB
settings.field.launchbox.label: LaunchBox box art for ROMs
settings.field.launchbox.help: Downloads the LaunchBox Games Database’s game list (about 110 MB) for your ROMs’ box art, and a new one once a week while your ROM library has games.
settings.field.panel_launchbox.label: LaunchBox game list
settings.launchbox.stored: The game list takes {size} on this computer.
settings.launchbox.off_hint: While this is off, Irori downloads nothing; the stored list keeps your ROMs’ covers until you remove it.
settings.launchbox.remove_body: This frees {size}. Your ROMs’ covers go back to libretro’s thumbnails until the list is downloaded again.
settings.field.art_cache_limit.label: Art cache size
settings.field.art_cache_limit.help: Disk space limit for cached covers and artwork.
settings.field.art_cache_limit.tip: Caps disk usage for downloaded thumbnails and artwork. Older unused images are cleared first without affecting games.
settings.field.igdb.help: Fetch extra game info and art from IGDB.
settings.field.igdb.tip: Fetches extra descriptions, release dates, genres, and artwork from IGDB when viewing game pages (great for sideloaded or emulated games).
settings.field.panel_igdb.label: IGDB application
settings.field.panel_igdb.tip: Enter your free Twitch developer client ID and secret so Irori can fetch metadata from IGDB.
settings.field.vndb.label: Visual novel details and art from VNDB

settings.field.ui_translucency.help: Soft glass effect behind the sidebar and title bar.

settings.field.ui_translucency.label: Translucency
settings.field.use_game_mode.help: Boost CPU priority while playing (needs GameMode).

settings.field.use_game_mode.label: GameMode
settings.field.verbose_logs.help: Include extra Wine and debug details in the game log.

settings.field.verbose_logs.label: Detailed launch log
settings.field.vkd3d_version.label: VKD3D-Proton version
settings.field.vkd3d_version.tip: Selects which VKD3D-Proton release to use with standalone Wine builds for DirectX 12 games. Newer versions often resolve crashes.
settings.field.wine_prefix.help: Folder holding this game’s simulated Windows files.

settings.field.wine_crossover_bottle.hel: Bottle name used when launching with CrossOver.
settings.field.wine_crossover_bottle.tip: Enter the exact name of a bottle you created in CrossOver so this game runs inside it.
settings.field.retina_mode.label: Retina mode
settings.field.retina_mode.help: Render at your Retina display’s full resolution.
settings.field.retina_mode.tip: Renders at full native Retina pixels instead of scaling up. Looks sharper on Mac screens, though older games may show tiny menus or cost more GPU.
settings.field.wine_version.label: Wine or Proton build
settings.field.wine_version.tip: Picks which Wine or Proton runner starts Windows games. GE-Proton is the best everyday default unless a game guide suggests another version.
settings.field.wrapper_options.help: Wrapper tools run around the game (outermost first).

settings.field.wrapper_options.label: Wrapper commands
settings.field.xess_upgrade.label: Upgrade XeSS
settings.field.xess_upgrade.tip: Automatically swaps older Intel XeSS libraries bundled with games for a newer version on compatible Proton builds.
settings.field.zoom_platform.label: ZOOM Platform store
settings.field.zoom_platform.tip: Enables the ZOOM Platform store tab for classic DRM-free PC games.
settings.field.itch_io.label: itch.io store
settings.field.itch_io.help: Enable itch.io sign-in and game installs.
settings.field.itch_io.tip: Adds itch.io to Accounts and your Library so you can sign in with an API key to install, update, and play games you own there.
