settings.field.file_achievements.label: Read achievements from game files
settings.field.file_achievements.help: Read offline achievement files from the game folder.
settings.field.file_achievements.tip: Reads local achievement unlock files saved in the game’s folder so offline achievements still register in Irori.
settings.field.steam_app_id.label: Steam app
settings.field.steam_app_id.help: The Steam game this one is: Steam’s tags, store details and ProtonDB follow it, and so do the achievements read from game files. “none” says Steam doesn’t sell it; leave it empty to find it on its own. The game still starts as before.
settings.field.steam_app_id.tip: Matches local achievement files to the right Steam game while “Read achievements from game files” is active. Leave blank for auto-detection.
settings.field.panel_replay.label: Recorder
settings.field.panel_replay.tip: Configure Irori’s instant replay buffer to save the last moments of gameplay with a shortcut without heavy CPU overhead.
settings.field.panel_umu.label: umu database
settings.field.panel_umu.tip: Look up this game in the umu compatibility database to confirm or pick its matching ID.
settings.field.replay_enabled.label: Keep a replay buffer
settings.field.replay_enabled.help: Continuously buffer recent gameplay in memory.
settings.field.replay_enabled.tip: Continuously keeps recent seconds or minutes of gameplay in RAM while playing so you can save clips on demand.
settings.field.replay_journal.help: Each clip you save is linked in that day’s journal note of the game.
settings.field.replay_journal.label: Add clips to the journal
settings.field.replay_monitor.help: The connector name of the monitor to record, such as DP-1, as the recorder’s line above lists them. Used when recording the whole screen.
settings.field.replay_monitor.label: Monitor
settings.field.replay_resolution.help: A larger screen is scaled down to this size, which makes smaller clips.
settings.field.replay_resolution.label: Clip size
settings.field.replay_restart.help: If gpu-screen-recorder stops by itself while you play, it starts again, up to three times.
settings.field.replay_restart.label: Restart the recorder if it stops
settings.field.replay_seconds.label: Clip length
settings.field.replay_seconds.tip: Sets how far back each saved replay clip goes. Longer clips use a bit more system memory while playing.
settings.field.replay_quality.label: Quality
settings.field.replay_quality.help: Higher quality creates larger files and uses more RAM.
settings.field.replay_quality.tip: Trades video crispness against file size and RAM used by the background replay buffer.
settings.field.replay_audio.label: Sound
settings.field.replay_audio.tip: Choose whether saved clips include game audio alone, microphone too, or video only.
settings.field.replay_capture.label: Record
settings.field.replay_capture.help: Pick direct screen capture or desktop prompt on Wayland.
settings.field.replay_capture.tip: Whole screen records without popups; choose Ask the desktop if your Wayland compositor blocks screen capture.
settings.field.replay_codec.help: Automatic picks one your GPU encodes. The recorder’s line above lists the codecs it found.
settings.field.replay_codec.label: Codec
settings.field.replay_folder.label: Clips folder
settings.field.replay_folder.tip: Directory where saved video clips are stored. Leave empty to use Irori’s default Videos location.
settings.field.replay_fps.label: Frame rate
settings.requires.replay: Turn on the replay buffer first
settings.replay.missing_help: Irori records with it and never bundles it. Install it from Flathub or your distribution’s packages, then refresh.
settings.replay.no_app_audio: This system can’t record only the game’s sound; that needs PipeWire.
settings.replay.recording: Recording the last {seconds} seconds of {title} at {fps} FPS
settings.replay.ways: Save a clip while you play
settings.replay.way_controller: Controller: hold Guide and press X (Square on PlayStation)
settings.replay.way_menus: Tray menu or command palette (Ctrl+K): Save clip
settings.replay.shortcut_ask: Keyboard: ask your desktop for shortcuts that work while the game has focus.
settings.replay.shortcut_clip_ready: Keyboard: the clip shortcut is set up
settings.replay.shortcut_clip_unassigned: Keyboard: the clip shortcut has no keys yet
settings.replay.shortcut_screenshot_read: Keyboard: the screenshot shortcut is set up
settings.replay.shortcut_screenshot_unas: Keyboard: the screenshot shortcut has no keys yet
settings.replay.shortcut_portal_change: Change the keys in your desktop’s shortcut settings.
settings.replay.shortcut_grabbed: Keyboard: {clip} saves a clip and {screenshot} takes a screenshot, whichever window has the focus.
settings.replay.shortcut_commands_file: Keyboard: {desktop} doesn’t let programs listen for keys pressed in other windows. Add these lines to {file}, then reload its configuration:
settings.replay.shortcut_commands_other: Keyboard: your desktop doesn’t let programs listen for keys pressed in other windows. Bind these commands to keys in its keyboard settings:
settings.replay.shortcut_unavailable: Keyboard: your desktop has no global shortcuts, so keys pressed in a game can’t reach Irori. Use the controller, the tray or the command palette.
settings.replay.memory: Holding {seconds} seconds takes about {size} MB of memory while a game runs.
settings.replay.clips_in: Clips go to {folder}, in a folder per game.
settings.field.action_import_bottles.hel: Import installed programs and games from Bottles.
settings.field.action_import_bottles.tip: Imports Windows games and programs from your Bottles prefixes into Irori while keeping each Bottle as its prefix. Bottles stays untouched.
settings.field.action_import_faugus.help: Import games and Proton settings from Faugus Launcher.
settings.field.action_import_faugus.tip: Imports games from Faugus Launcher along with their prefixes, Proton versions, environment variables, and launch arguments without changing Faugus.
settings.field.action_import_playnite.he: Import Playnite’s installed games, metadata, and playtime.
settings.field.action_import_playnite.ti: Brings over Playnite’s installed games, artwork, playtime, favourites, and categories while matching Steam, Epic, and GOG duplicates. Close Playnite first; it stays untouched.
settings.field.action_open_windows_files: Lets double-clicking Windows .exe, .msi, .bat, or .reg files in your file manager open them inside any game’s Wine prefix.
settings.windows_files.done: Windows programs now open with Irori
settings.windows_files.failed: Couldn't make Irori the program for Windows files
settings.field.achievement_notices.label: Announce new achievements
settings.field.achievement_notices.help: While a game runs, Irori shows each unlock as it happens, then once more when the game closes. It follows GOG Galaxy’s and Steam’s own reports; for other games it checks every few minutes (every minute for achievements kept in the game’s files), and only while the game runs.
settings.field.achievement_notices.tip: Shows a desktop notification popup when Irori detects that you unlocked an achievement while playing.
settings.field.achievement_toast_over_ga: A card in the top right corner of the screen that never takes the game’s focus. Where nothing can show over the game (GNOME, a game in exclusive fullscreen on Windows), or while Irori’s window is in front, unlocks are notifications instead.
Unlocks show how rare they are
settings.field.achievement_toast_line.he: A line under the achievement’s name, over the game and in the in-game overlay. Lines the store doesn’t fill in are left out.
settings.field.start_with_system.label: Start at login
settings.field.start_with_system.help: Launch Irori when you sign in to your PC.
settings.field.start_with_system.tip: Starts Irori automatically when you log into your computer so your library and background updates are ready.
settings.field.start_with_system_minimiz: Start minimized to tray at login
Start quietly in the tray when signing in.
When starting at login, keeps the window tucked in the system tray instead of opening over your desktop.
settings.steam_compat.heading: Steam Play
settings.steam_compat.label: Compatibility tool
settings.steam_compat.help: The Proton build Steam runs this game with. Irori changes only this game's choice in Steam's settings.
settings.steam_compat.running: Steam is running and overwrites its settings when it exits, so Irori asks to close it before saving a new choice.
settings.steam_compat.session: Steam runs this session, so change the tool in the game's properties in Steam.
settings.steam_compat.none_found: No compatibility tools found. Steam installs Proton when a game first needs it, and Proton builds from the Wine manager appear here when “Install Proton downloads into Steam” is on.
settings.steam_compat.footer: Steam uses the new choice from its next start. Before each change Irori keeps the previous settings file as config.vdf.irori-backup.
settings.steam_compat.load_failed: Steam's compatibility tools couldn't be read
settings.steam_compat.saved_default: Steam will run “{title}” with its default tool
settings.steam_compat.close.title: Close Steam to change “{title}”?
settings.steam_compat.close.description: Steam closes, along with any game it is running, and Irori then switches to {tool}. Playing the game starts Steam again.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.none: ProtonDB has no rating for this game yet.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.native: Native: the game has a Linux version, so it needs no compatibility tool.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.platinum: Platinum: runs perfectly out of the box. Steam's default should do.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.gold: Gold: runs perfectly after tweaks. The reports say which.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.silver: Silver: runs with minor issues. A newer Proton or GE-Proton may help.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.bronze: Bronze: runs, but often with problems. Try Proton Experimental or GE-Proton.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.borked: Borked: reported not to run. Read the reports before trying another tool.
settings.steam_compat.protondb.pending: Pending: too few reports for a rating yet.
settings.field.ui_cover_categories.label: Show categories on covers
settings.field.ui_cover_categories.help: Show up to two category tags at the bottom of covers.
settings.field.ui_cover_categories.tip: Displays up to two category tags at the bottom of each game poster for quick filtering at a glance.
settings.field.ui_cover_corners.label: Cover corners
settings.field.ui_cover_fit.label: Box art
settings.field.ui_cover_fit.help: Cropped fills every cover to the library’s 2:3 shape. Whole shows each picture uncut in its own shape, tall, square or wide; the tall boxes of a row share one height.
settings.field.ui_cover_shape.label: Cover shape
settings.field.ui_cover_shape.help: For the grid. Square uses the store’s square art where it has one, a banner the game’s wide art; other art is cropped to fit.
settings.field.ui_cover_caption.label: Under covers
settings.field.ui_cover_caption.help: Without the title, a game’s name still shows when its cover has none, and on its page.
settings.option.cover_caption.title: Title only
settings.field.ui_cover_hover.label: Pointed-at covers
settings.field.ui_focus_columns.label: Covers to a row in Focus view
settings.field.ui_focus_columns.help: Fewer when the window is too narrow for the game page beside them. You can also drag the column’s edge.
settings.field.ui_auto_layout.label: Switch between grid and Focus with the window’s width
settings.field.ui_auto_layout.help: Focus once the window has room for the game page beside the covers, the grid when it is narrower. Choosing a view yourself holds until the window crosses that width again; the list stays as it is.
settings.field.ui_focus_cover_size.label: Cover size in Focus view
settings.field.ui_open_details_on_select: Open details when a cover is clicked
In the grid. Off, a click only selects the game: I opens its details beside the grid, Enter or a double click its page.
settings.field.ui_cover_favourite.label: Star favourites’ covers
settings.field.ui_group_copies.label: Group copies across stores
settings.field.ui_group_copies.help: Combine duplicate copies from multiple stores into one card.
settings.field.ui_group_copies.tip: Merges games you own on multiple stores into one card and lets you switch copies from the game’s page.
settings.field.ui_program_icon_art.label: Show the program's icon on games without art
settings.field.ui_program_icon_art.help: A game without cover art, such as one you added yourself, shows the icon of its Windows program on its stand-in cover. Your own art and the store's always come first.
settings.field.ui_trailer_autoplay.label: Play a game’s trailer when its page opens
settings.field.ui_trailer_autoplay.help: The first trailer starts muted and loops. Trailers play through ffmpeg on this computer; on Windows, Irori can download it.
settings.field.ui_show_age_ratings.label: Show age ratings
settings.field.ui_show_age_ratings.help: A game’s page shows its age rating and content descriptors. The library’s age filter works either way.
settings.field.ui_age_rating_board.label: Rating board shown first
settings.field.ui_age_rating_board.help: Automatic shows the board of your region, told by the interface language and the system’s locale. Other boards’ ratings follow it.
settings.field.umu_id.label: umu game id
settings.field.umu_id.help: Compatibility ID used by umu for Proton fixes.
settings.field.umu_id.tip: Tells umu which game’s Proton fixes to apply. Leave empty so Irori matches it automatically from store data, Steam App ID, or title.
settings.field.xbox.label: Xbox store
settings.field.xbox.help: Install and play Microsoft Store and PC Game Pass games.
settings.field.xbox.tip: Enables Microsoft Store and PC Game Pass support on Linux via Nexus Runtime.
settings.field.xbox_market.label: Microsoft Store region
settings.field.xbox_market.help: Two-letter country code (blank follows app language).
settings.field.xbox_market.tip: Sets the two-letter regional store code (such as US, BR, DE, or GB) used for Microsoft Store lookups. Leave blank to follow your app language.
settings.field.xbox_market.off: Turn on the Xbox store first.
settings.umu.looking: Looking for this game’s umu id…
settings.umu.hint: The id only matters when umu runs the game with Proton. The database is downloaded from umu’s project once a week.
settings.umu.none: No umu id found: umu runs the game without game-specific fixes.
settings.umu.no_results: The umu database lists no game by that title.
settings.umu.source.store: from the umu database’s entry for its store
settings.umu.source.title: matched by its title in the umu database
settings.field.hide_pointer.label: Hide the pointer while using a controller
settings.field.hide_pointer.help: A button or stick press hides the mouse pointer until the mouse moves again.
settings.page.controller_description: What each button does, the buttons shown and how a controller moves around Irori
settings.field.panel_button_map.label: What the buttons do
settings.controller_map.screens.move: Move between items, and on to the next control at a list’s edge
settings.controller_map.screens.confirm: Press the focused button or open the focused item
settings.controller_map.screens.back: Close the topmost window, or go back
settings.controller_map.screens.prev: Previous page, or the previous control
settings.controller_map.screens.next: Next page, or the next control
settings.controller_map.big_picture.move: Move between games, shelves and rows
settings.controller_map.big_picture.conf: Open the focused game, or choose the focused row
settings.controller_map.big_picture.back: Go back; on Home, leave Big Picture
settings.controller_map.overlay.guide: Open or close the overlay over a running game
settings.controller_map.guide.clip: Save a clip of the replay buffer
settings.controller_map.guide.screenshot: Take a screenshot (with the overlay on)
settings.controller_map.guide.volume_up: Turn the system volume up (with the overlay on)
settings.controller_map.guide.volume_dow: Turn the system volume down (with the overlay on)
settings.controller_map.stranded: One button must confirm and another must go back.
settings.controller_map.everywhere: Changes apply in Big Picture, the overlay and every other screen. Guide, the D-pad and the sticks keep their jobs.
settings.field.nav_sounds.label: Navigation sounds
settings.field.nav_sounds.help: A short tone in Big Picture when the focus moves, something opens or closes, or the tab changes. Choosing one plays a sample. On Linux it needs pw-play, paplay or aplay.
settings.field.nav_sound_volume.label: Navigation sound volume
settings.field.nav_sound_volume.help: In percent, from 1 to 100. Even at 100 the tones stay well under a game’s sound.
settings.field.idle_minutes.label: Idle screen after
settings.field.idle_minutes.help: Minutes without input before Big Picture shows the idle screen; 0 never shows it. Any button, key or mouse movement brings Big Picture back.
settings.field.idle_screen.label: Idle screen
settings.field.steam_tag_limit.help: How many of a game’s strongest Steam tags the library keeps, from 5 to 20. Tags that far fewer players gave than the strongest one are left out.
settings.field.steam_tag_limit.label: Steam tags per game
settings.field.steam_title_match.help: Links games of other stores to the Steam app with the same title (edition names aside, released within a year of it) when no wiki names one, for Steam’s tags, store details and ProtonDB. A few games are looked up at a time, and the answers are kept for a month.
settings.field.steam_title_match.label: Find games on Steam by their exact title
settings.option.idle_screen.slideshow: Your games’ art, one after another
settings.field.quick_launch_shortcut.lab: Open the quick launcher with a shortcut
settings.field.quick_launch_shortcut.hel: The quick launcher is the command palette in a small window of its own: find a game and play it, or go back to it, without bringing Irori to the front. Irori asks your desktop for Ctrl+Alt+K; where it can’t, bind the command shown below to a key yourself.
settings.field.panel_quick_launch.label: Quick launcher shortcut
settings.field.panel_how_it_starts.label: How it starts
settings.field.panel_how_it_starts.help: The command, wrappers and variables the next launch uses, worked out without starting anything.
settings.quick_launch.asking: Asking your desktop for the shortcut…
settings.quick_launch.keys: {keys} opens the quick launcher from anywhere.
settings.quick_launch.ready: Your desktop holds the quick launcher’s shortcut; change its keys in the desktop’s shortcut settings.
settings.quick_launch.unassigned: Your desktop has no keys for the quick launcher yet; give it some in the desktop’s shortcut settings.
settings.quick_launch.commands_file: {desktop} doesn’t let programs listen for keys pressed in other windows. Add this to {file}, then reload its configuration:
settings.quick_launch.command: Bind this command to a key in your desktop’s keyboard settings:
settings.quick_launch.off: This command opens the quick launcher too; bind it to a key in your desktop’s keyboard settings if you like:
settings.how_it_starts.rosetta: Its Intel program starts through Rosetta.
settings.how_it_starts.copied_masked: Copied the command. Hidden values stay hidden: put them back before running it.
settings.how_it_starts.loading: Working out how the game starts…
settings.how_it_starts.failed: Couldn’t work out how the game starts
settings.how_it_starts.handed_over: Another program starts this game with its own settings.
settings.how_it_starts.program_from_stor: The store names the program as the game starts; the command shows its folder.
settings.how_it_starts.sandboxed: It runs in a bubblewrap sandbox, whose options are set as it starts.
settings.how_it_starts.store_note: The store may add its own arguments as the game starts.
settings.how_it_starts.masked: Values of tokens, keys and passwords are hidden.
settings.how_it_starts.without_wine: Its program is one of this system’s, so it starts without Wine.
settings.field.rosetta.label: Run with Rosetta
settings.field.rosetta.help: Starts the game’s Intel version even when it also has one for Apple silicon, for games whose Apple silicon version misbehaves. Games made only for Intel Macs always run with Rosetta.
settings.field.metal_fx_dlss.label: DLSS through MetalFX
settings.field.metal_fx_dlss.help: Lets games that use NVIDIA DLSS upscale with Apple’s MetalFX. Only Wine builds that ship it can: Game Porting Toolkit 3, a recent CrossOver or a DXMT build. With others it stays off and the game log says why.
settings.field.shortcut_icon_from_exe.he: Shortcuts of Windows games use the icon inside the game’s .exe, before the store’s art.
settings.field.launcher_sync_faugus.labe: Keep Faugus Launcher games in sync
settings.field.launcher_sync.help: Irori reads the launcher again at start and every 15 minutes and adds the games it hasn’t seen. Games you removed from Irori stay out, and the launcher’s files are only read.
settings.optiscaler.shortcut.help: Key that opens the OptiScaler overlay in-game (writes [Menu] ShortcutKey in OptiScaler.ini). Click and press a key, or press Esc to cancel.
settings.optiscaler.shortcut.label: Menu shortcut key
settings.optiscaler.steam_note: Steam launches this game with Proton. Irori syncs Wine DLL overrides in the game’s Proton prefix so no Steam Launch Options are needed.
settings.hud.alpha.help: Opacity of overlay text and graph elements.
settings.hud.alpha.label: Text opacity
settings.hud.background_alpha.help: Transparency of the overlay card behind the metrics.
settings.hud.background_alpha.label: Background opacity
settings.hud.color.low_contrast: Low contrast between Text and Background ({ratio}:1; recommended 4.5:1 or higher).
settings.hud.cpu_label.help: Optional short name shown in the overlay. Leave empty to use the detected name.
settings.hud.cpu_label.label: CPU label
settings.hud.font_scale.help: Scale overlay text size relative to the default font.
settings.hud.font_scale.label: Font scale
settings.hud.fps_color_change.help: Tint the FPS number green, yellow, or red depending on frame rate.
settings.hud.fps_color_change.label: Color FPS by threshold
settings.hud.fps_limit.help: Cap frame rate inside MangoHud. Set to Off for uncapped frame rates.
settings.hud.fps_limit.label: FPS limit
settings.hud.fps_limit_method.help: Late lowers input latency; Early produces steadier frame pacing.
settings.hud.fps_limit_method.label: Frame limiter method
settings.hud.gpu_label.help: Optional short name shown in the overlay. Leave empty to use the detected name.
settings.hud.gpu_label.label: GPU label
settings.hud.gpu_selection.help: Choose which graphics card MangoHud monitors on multi-GPU systems.
settings.hud.gpu_selection.label: Monitored GPU
settings.hud.hud_compact.help: Reduce padding and row spacing for a tighter overlay.
settings.hud.hud_compact.label: Compact spacing
settings.hud.hud_no_margin.help: Place the HUD flush against the screen edge.
settings.hud.hud_no_margin.label: Remove outer margin
settings.hud.mangohud_dlsym.help: Intercept OpenGL symbols loaded dynamically via dlsym when the legacy wrapper is enabled.
settings.hud.mangohud_dlsym.label: Enable MANGOHUD_DLSYM
settings.hud.metal.alignment.help: Choose which screen corner displays Apple's Metal Performance HUD.
settings.hud.metal.alignment.label: HUD corner
settings.hud.metal.note: Works with native Metal games as well as Wine, CrossOver, D3DMetal (Game Porting Toolkit), DXMT, and MoltenVK.
settings.hud.metric.cpu_mhz_help: Show current CPU frequency in MHz.
settings.hud.metric.cpu_power_help: Show processor power consumption in watts.
settings.hud.metric.cpu_stats_locked: Required while any CPU sensor below is enabled.
settings.hud.metric.fps_use_label: Use FPS label instead of API name
settings.hud.metric.fps_use_label_help: Show FPS instead of VKD3D, DXVK, Vulkan or OpenGL on the FPS row.
settings.hud.metric.fps_avg_help: Show rolling average frames per second.
settings.hud.metric.fps_1_low_help: Show 1% low frames per second to spot frame drops.
settings.hud.metric.frame_timing_help: Show a live frametime chart to spot stutter.
settings.hud.metric.frametime_help: Show time per frame in milliseconds.
settings.hud.metric.fsr_help: Show whether AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution is active.
settings.hud.metric.gamemode_help: Show whether Feral GameMode is active.
settings.hud.metric.gpu_core_clock_help: Show current GPU core frequency in MHz.
settings.hud.metric.gpu_mem_clock_help: Show GPU video memory frequency in MHz.
settings.hud.metric.gpu_fan_help: Show GPU cooling fan speed in RPM.
settings.hud.metric.gpu_junction_temp_he: Show GPU junction or hotspot temperature where supported.
settings.hud.metric.gpu_mem_temp_help: Show graphics memory temperature where supported.
settings.hud.metric.gpu_power_help: Show GPU power consumption in watts.
settings.hud.metric.gpu_stats_locked: Required while any GPU sensor below is enabled.
settings.hud.metric.hdr_help: Show whether HDR output is active.
settings.hud.metric.present_mode_help: Show the active swapchain present mode (VSync, Mailbox, Immediate).
settings.hud.metric.throttling_status_he: Show thermal, power, or current throttling warnings.
settings.hud.metric.wine_help: Show the active Wine or Proton runtime version.
settings.hud.metric.winesync_help: Show the active synchronization backend (NTSYNC, Fsync, Esync).
settings.hud.missing.description: Install MangoHud with your system package manager to display the overlay. If you run Irori as a Flatpak, also install the org.freedesktop.Platform.VulkanLayer.MangoHud extension.
settings.hud.missing.title: MangoHud was not detected
settings.hud.mode.disabled_note: Explicitly disables in-game stats for this game.
settings.hud.mode.game_help: Override the global in-game stats setting for this game.
settings.hud.mode.global_help: Turn in-game stats on or off for games Irori starts.
settings.hud.mode.label: HUD mode
settings.hud.mode.off_note: Irori will not modify HUD environment variables when launching games.
settings.hud.no_display.help: Keep the overlay hidden at game launch until toggled with the shortcut.
settings.hud.no_display.label: Start hidden
settings.hud.opengl_wrapper.help: Wrap this native Linux OpenGL game with the mangohud command. Not needed for Vulkan or Wine/Proton games.
settings.hud.opengl_wrapper.label: OpenGL legacy wrapper (LD_PRELOAD)
settings.hud.orientation.help: Stack metrics in a compact vertical column or a single horizontal bar.
settings.hud.orientation.label: Orientation
settings.hud.palette.help: Hardware colors use each maker's brand color for the GPU and CPU. You can also follow Irori's theme, use gray tones only or pick every color yourself.
settings.hud.palette.label: Color palette
settings.hud.position.help: Corner or edge where the HUD anchors on screen.
settings.hud.position.label: Overlay position
settings.hud.presets.help: Start from a ready-made layout. Editing any toggle below switches this to Custom.
settings.hud.presets.label: Quick preset
settings.hud.preview.test_failed: Could not launch Vulkan HUD test
settings.hud.preview.title: Preview
settings.hud.restore_from_global_help: Replace this game's custom HUD settings with a fresh copy of your global defaults.
settings.hud.round_corners.help: Corner radius of the HUD background in pixels.
settings.hud.round_corners.label: Corner rounding
settings.hud.cycle_order.label: In-game cycle order (starts at the highlighted preset)
settings.hud.shortcut.click_to_record: Click to record a new shortcut
settings.hud.shortcut.conflict: Both shortcuts use the same key combination. Change one so toggling and cycling do not collide in-game.
settings.hud.shortcut.side_left_tooltip: Use left modifier keys (Shift_L, Control_L, Alt_L)
settings.hud.shortcut.side_right_tooltip: Use right modifier keys (Shift_R, Control_R, Alt_R)
settings.hud.shortcut.wayland_note: On pure Wayland native windows, global hotkeys may require an XWayland game or compositor support.
settings.hud.steam.card_subtitle: Steam manages its own launch environment. Paste this command in the game’s Launch Options in Steam.
settings.hud.steam.copied: Steam launch options copied to clipboard
settings.hud.steam.description: Steam starts games in its own process tree, so Irori cannot inject HUD variables directly. Copy the launch options below into the game's Properties in Steam.
settings.hud.steam.none_needed: No Steam launch options are needed while the HUD is turned off or disabled.
settings.hud.steam.title: Steam manages its own launch environment
settings.hud.steam_guide.title: How to paste into Steam
settings.hud.steam_guide.subtitle: Steam starts games in its own process tree, so paste these options once in the game’s Steam Properties.
settings.hud.steam_guide.step1.title: Open Steam Library
settings.hud.steam_guide.step1.body: Open Steam and find the game in your Library list.
settings.hud.steam_guide.step1.body_game: Open Steam and find “{title}” in your Library list.
settings.hud.steam_guide.step2.title: Open Properties
settings.hud.steam_guide.step2.body: Right-click the game in the sidebar and click Properties.
settings.hud.steam_guide.step3.title: Scroll to Launch Options
settings.hud.steam_guide.step3.body: Stay in the General tab and find the Launch Options text box at the bottom.
settings.hud.steam_guide.step4.title: Paste and close
settings.hud.steam_guide.step4.body: Paste the copied command there and close the window. Steam saves it right away.
settings.hud.steam_guide.mock.title: Properties
settings.hud.toggle_hud.help: Press this key combination in-game to show or hide the overlay.
settings.hud.toggle_hud.label: Toggle shortcut
settings.hud.toggle_preset.help: Press this key combination in-game to cycle through Irori's HUD presets.
settings.hud.toggle_preset.label: Cycle presets shortcut
settings.hud.unsupported: In-game stats are not available on this platform.
settings.page.performance_hud_descriptio: Shows FPS, temperatures and hardware usage on top of your games, via MangoHud.
Shows FPS, temperatures and hardware usage on top of your games, via Metal HUD.
settings.field.panel_performance_hud.tip: Customize which stats appear in the overlay for this game alone, or inherit the global Performance HUD layout.
settings.field.panel_optiscaler.label: OptiScaler
settings.field.panel_optiscaler.tip: Install and configure OptiScaler upscaling bridge, proxy DLL, OptiPatcher, and in-game overlay shortcut key.
settings.hud.global_stores_notice: Applies automatically to games and third-party launchers started by Irori. For Steam games, paste the launch options into Steam. For per-game profiles, open Game Settings > Performance > In-game stats.
settings.hud.launcher_restart_notice: The overlay is applied when Irori starts this launcher. If it is already running in the background, close and reopen it so mode changes take effect.
settings.group_desc.stores: Hidden stores keep your sign-in and installed games, but stay out of your library.
settings.group_desc.upscalers: Requires a compatible Proton build, such as Proton-CachyOS.
settings.group_desc.wine_sync: Speed up Windows games by letting Wine handle background tasks faster.
settings.pair.update_hours_help: Automatic updates only start inside this window.
settings.pair.update_hours.tip: Restricts unattended automatic game and tool downloads to specific hours (such as overnight). Manual updates always start right away.
settings.pair.game_resolution.tip: Internal rendering size reported to the game inside gamescope. Lowering this (like 1280×720) with upscaling enabled boosts FPS cleanly.
settings.pair.output_resolution.tip: Final window or display resolution shown on your monitor (usually your display’s native width and height).
settings.pair.fps_limits.tip: Caps frame rate inside gamescope while playing and optionally sets a lower FPS cap when Alt-Tabbed in the background.
settings.pair.controller_repeat_help: Tune how soon held buttons start scrolling menus.
settings.pair.controller_repeat.tip: Controls how quickly controller D-pad or stick scrolling kicks in when held: initial delay sets the first wait, interval sets repeat speed afterward.
settings.crash.title: Crash report
settings.crash.privacy_note: Nothing is sent automatically. Review the report below before copying, uploading or opening a GitHub issue.
settings.crash.copied_for_github: Crash report copied. Paste it into the GitHub issue.
settings.crash.recent_help: Reports from unexpected exits stay here until you remove them.
settings.field.ui_cover_compat_badges.la: ProtonDB and Steam Deck badges on covers
settings.field.ui_cover_compat_badges.he: Show ProtonDB ratings and Steam Deck Verified badges on covers of games that aren’t installed.
settings.field.ui_library_greeting.label: Show greeting in library header
settings.field.ui_library_greeting.help: Greet you by time of day at the top of the Library. Click your name there to edit or hide it.
